content:
Workload: maposcal-demo/Job/data-migration-v2
Namespace: maposcal-demo
Controller: Job data-migration-v2
Type: controller
Selectors: {'app': 'migration', 'component': 'data-migration', 'tier': 'maintenance', 'version': 'v2.0.0'}

ConfigMaps:
  - migration-scripts: ['001_create_new_tables.sql', '002_migrate_data.sql']
  - migration-config: ['migration.yml']

Secrets:
  - migration-secrets: Opaque

ServiceAccount: migration-sa

RBAC:
  - ServiceAccount: migration-sa
  - RoleBinding: migration-role-binding
  - Role: migration-role

Workload: maposcal-demo/Pod/utility-pod
Namespace: maposcal-demo
Controller: Pod utility-pod
Type: controller
Selectors: {'app': 'utility', 'component': 'maintenance', 'tier': 'utility', 'version': 'v1.0.0'}

ConfigMaps:
  - utility-config: ['utility.yml']

Secrets:
  - utility-secrets: Opaque

ServiceAccount: utility-sa

RBAC:
  - ServiceAccount: utility-sa
  - RoleBinding: utility-role-binding
  - Role: utility-role

Workload: maposcal-demo/CronJob/database-backup
Namespace: maposcal-demo
Controller: CronJob database-backup
Type: controller
Selectors: {}

Workload: maposcal-demo/Deployment/webapp-frontend
Namespace: maposcal-demo
Controller: Deployment webapp-frontend
Type: controller
Selectors: {'app': 'webapp', 'component': 'frontend', 'tier': 'web', 'version': 'v1.0.0'}

Sub-workloads: maposcal-demo/Service/webapp-service

Services:
  - webapp-service: {'app': 'webapp', 'component': 'frontend', 'tier': 'web'}

Ingress:
  - webapp-ingress: ['webapp-service']
  - shared-ingress: ['webapp-service', 'shared-service']

ConfigMaps:
  - nginx-config: ['default.conf']
  - webapp-config: ['nginx.conf', 'app.config']

Secrets:
  - webapp-secrets: Opaque

ServiceAccount: webapp-sa

Shared Resources:
  - Service:webapp-service
  - Ingress:webapp-ingress
  - Ingress:shared-ingress
  - ConfigMap:nginx-config
  - ConfigMap:webapp-config
  - Secret:webapp-secrets
Storage:
  - PVC: webapp-data-pvc

Resilience:
  - HPA: webapp-hpa

RBAC:
  - ServiceAccount: webapp-sa
  - RoleBinding: webapp-role-binding
  - RoleBinding: shared-role-binding
  - Role: webapp-role
  - Role: shared-role

Secrets:

ServiceAccount: postgres-sa

Shared Resources:
  - Service:postgres-service
  - ConfigMap:postgres-config
  - Secret:postgres-secrets
RBAC:
  - ServiceAccount: postgres-sa
  - RoleBinding: postgres-role-binding
  - RoleBinding: shared-role-binding
  - Role: postgres-role
  - Role: shared-role
